name: @instatic/huggingface
description: HuggingFace Hub integration — search models, datasets, Spaces, and run inference.

instaticManifest.name: HuggingFace
instaticManifest.description: Seamlessly interact with HuggingFace Hub: search models, datasets, and Spaces, get model details, and run inference on 800K+ ML models.

settings.label: HuggingFace API Token
settings.description: Access token from https://huggingface.co/settings/tokens. Required for inference; optional for public search.

aiTools.name: search_models
aiTools.description: Search the HuggingFace Hub for AI/ML models by keyword, task type, author, tags, language, or sort by popularity (downloads, likes, trending). Returns model ID, downloads, likes, tags, and pipeline task. Supports advanced filtering by multiple tags and programming language.

task.description: Filter by pipeline task: text-generation, text-classification, image-classification, image-generation, summarization, translation, question-answering, token-classification, speech-recognition, text-to-speech, fill-mask, etc.

library.description: Filter by ML library: transformers, diffusers, timm, sentence-transformers, onnx, keras, safetensors, etc.

tags.description: Filter by tags (e.g. ['pytorch', 'safetensors', 'llama']). Models must have ALL specified tags.

full.description: Return full model details including config, siblings, and card metadata. Slower but more complete.

aiTools.name: get_model_info
aiTools.description: Get comprehensive information about a specific HuggingFace model: description, tags, pipeline type, downloads, likes, config, library, siblings (file list), and README snippet. Use this to deep-dive into a model's structure and capabilities.

with_files.description: Include sibling files list (config.json, model weights, tokenizer files, etc.)

aiTools.name: search_datasets
aiTools.description: Search the HuggingFace Hub for datasets by keyword, task, author, tags, language, or size category. Returns dataset ID, downloads, likes, and tags.

task.description: Filter by task type: text-classification, token-classification, question-answering, text-generation, summarization, translation, image-classification, object-detection, speech-recognition, etc.

tags.description: Filter by tags (e.g. ['text', 'english', 'classification']). Datasets must have ALL specified tags.

size_category.description: Filter by dataset size: n<1K, 1K<n<10K, 10K<n<100K, 100K<n<1M, 1M<n<10M, 10M<n<100M, 100M<n<1B, n>1B

aiTools.name: search_spaces
aiTools.description: Search the HuggingFace Hub for Spaces (interactive ML app demos) by keyword or author. Returns Space ID, author, SDK, likes, and status.

aiTools.name: run_inference
aiTools.description: Run inference on a HuggingFace model using the Serverless Inference API. Supports text generation, text classification, image classification, summarization, question answering, NER, translation, and more. Requires an API token (set in plugin settings or HUGGINGFACE_API_TOKEN env var) for most models.

inputs.description: Input text for the model (prompt, sentence, question, etc.)

parameters.description: Optional model-specific parameters (e.g. {max_new_tokens: 100, temperature: 0.7, top_p: 0.9} for text generation)

aiTools.name: get_dataset_info
aiTools.description: Get detailed information about a specific HuggingFace dataset: description, tags, download stats, file tree listing, and README content. Use this to inspect a dataset before downloading or to understand its structure.

aiTools.name: list_repo_files
aiTools.description: List files and directories in a HuggingFace repository (model, dataset, or Space). Returns paths, types (file/directory), sizes, and LFS status. Useful for exploring repo contents before downloading or backing up.

path.description: Subdirectory path to list (e.g. 'data', 'configs', 'src'). Leave empty for root.

aiTools.name: create_repo
aiTools.description: Create a new repository on HuggingFace Hub: model, dataset, or Space. Requires a write-enabled API token (set in plugin settings or HUGGINGFACE_API_TOKEN env var). For Spaces, specify the SDK (gradio, streamlit, or static).

name.description: Repository name. For personal repos: 'my-repo'. For organization repos: 'org-name/repo-name'.

sdk.description: For Spaces only: UI framework. Options: gradio, streamlit, static.

description.description: Repository description / README content (used as initial README.md).

aiTools.name: upload_file
aiTools.description: Upload a text file to a HuggingFace repository (model, dataset, or Space). Requires a write-enabled API token. Useful for uploading configs, README updates, code files, or small dataset files. For large binary files, use the HuggingFace CLI or Git LFS instead.

path_in_repo.description: Target file path inside the repository (e.g. 'README.md', 'data/train.json', 'app.py')

aiTools.name: get_repo_readme
aiTools.description: Fetch the README.md content of a HuggingFace repository (model, dataset, or Space). Returns the raw markdown text, useful for understanding what a repo does without browsing the website.

aiTools.name: get_whoami
aiTools.description: Get the current authenticated HuggingFace user information: username, name, email, organizations, and token permissions. Useful for verifying that the API token is configured correctly.

aiTools.name: download_file
aiTools.description: Get a direct download link or raw content of a file from a HuggingFace repository (model, dataset, or Space). Supports downloading text files, config files, small dataset slices, etc. For large files or folders, use run_hf_command with 'hf download' instead.

revision.description: Git revision: branch name, tag, or commit hash. Defaults to 'main'.

return_content.description: If true and file is text-based, return the file content. Otherwise return the download URL only.

aiTools.name: delete_repo
aiTools.description: Delete a HuggingFace repository (model, dataset, or Space). This action is irreversible. Requires a write-enabled API token with admin permissions.

aiTools.name: delete_file
aiTools.description: Delete a file from a HuggingFace repository (model, dataset, or Space). Requires a write-enabled API token. This action creates a new commit removing the file.

path_in_repo.description: File path inside the repository to delete (e.g. 'data/old.json', 'README.md')

aiTools.name: get_trending
aiTools.description: Get trending models, datasets, or Spaces from HuggingFace Hub. Returns the most popular items in the last 24 hours or 7 days.

type.description: Type of item to get trending

aiTools.name: list_collections
aiTools.description: Search HuggingFace Collections (curated lists of models, datasets, and Spaces). Collections are user-curated groupings of related resources.

aiTools.name: list_repo_refs
aiTools.description: List branches, tags, and commits in a HuggingFace repository. Useful for finding specific versions or tracking repository history.

include.description: What to include: branches, tags, or commits

aiTools.name: run_hf_command
aiTools.description: Execute a HuggingFace hf CLI command for advanced operations not covered by REST API: download entire repositories/folders (hf download), upload folders (hf upload), list jobs (hf jobs), manage inference endpoints (hf endpoints), manage cache (hf cache), etc. Requires hf CLI to be installed. The token is automatically injected from plugin settings. Output is parsed as JSON when available.

command.description: hf subcommand to run (e.g. 'download', 'upload', 'jobs ps', 'cache dir', 'auth whoami'). Do NOT include 'hf' prefix.

args.description: Additional positional arguments (e.g. repo_id, file paths).

flags.description: Additional flags as key-value pairs (e.g. {"local-dir": "./models", "include": "*.safetensors"}). Boolean flags use true as value.

json_output.description: Add --json flag to get structured JSON output (recommended for agent parsing).

instaticManifest.systemPrompt:
You are a HuggingFace Hub integration assistant. You can search for AI/ML models, datasets, and Spaces, inspect repository contents, create/delete repositories, upload/download/delete files, run inference, discover trending items and collections, and execute advanced hf CLI commands.

## Capabilities
- **search_models**: Find models by keyword, task type, library (transformers, diffusers, etc.), author, tags, or language. Sort by popularity. Use this when users want to discover models for a task. Set full=true for complete metadata.
- **get_model_info**: Get comprehensive info about a specific model: README snippet, tags, downloads, config, library, and sibling files (config.json, weights, tokenizer). Use this after search to deep-dive into model structure.
- **search_datasets**: Find datasets for training or evaluation. Filter by task, tags, language, or size category. Sort by 'created' to find the newest datasets.
- **get_dataset_info**: Get full dataset details including file tree and README. Use this to inspect a dataset's structure before downloading.
- **search_spaces**: Find interactive ML app demos on HuggingFace Spaces.
- **get_trending**: Discover trending models, datasets, or Spaces from the last 24 hours or 7 days.
- **list_collections**: Search user-curated collections of related models, datasets, and Spaces.
- **list_repo_files**: List files in any repository (model/dataset/space). Use this to explore contents, check file sizes, or find specific files.
- **list_repo_refs**: List branches, tags, or commits in a repository. Useful for finding specific versions.
- **get_repo_readme**: Fetch the README markdown of any repository.
- **download_file**: Get a direct download URL or raw content of a specific file in a repo.
- **run_inference**: Run a model on input text. Requires an API token.
- **create_repo**: Create a new model, dataset, or Space repository. Supports description and license. Requires a write-enabled API token.
- **upload_file**: Upload a text file to a repository. Requires a write-enabled API token.
- **delete_file**: Delete a file from a repository. Creates a new commit. Requires write token.
- **delete_repo**: Delete a repository. Irreversible. Requires admin token.
- **get_whoami**: Verify the configured API token and show current user info.
- **run_hf_command**: Execute advanced hf CLI commands: download entire repos/folders, upload folders, manage jobs/endpoints/cache, etc. Requires hf CLI installation.

## Guidelines
- When a user asks about a task (e.g. 'I need a sentiment analysis model'), use search_models with the appropriate task and library filters first.
- To find the latest datasets, use search_datasets with sort='created'.
- To back up or inspect a dataset, first use get_dataset_info to see its structure, then use list_repo_files to explore subdirectories. For downloading single files, use download_file. For downloading entire repos or folders, use run_hf_command with 'download'.
- For creating Spaces: set repo_type='space' and choose sdk='gradio' (default UI), 'streamlit', or 'static'. You can also provide an initial description that becomes the README.
- Always present model/dataset results in a clear format: ID, type, downloads, likes, and brief description.
- For inference and write operations, ensure the user has set their HuggingFace API token in plugin settings. If no token is configured, inform them how to get one at https://huggingface.co/settings/tokens.
- Before destructive operations (delete_repo, delete_file), confirm the user's intent.
- For run_hf_command, prefer --json output for structured data. If hf CLI is not installed, guide the user to install it via 'pip install -U huggingface_hub' or 'curl -LsSf https://huggingface.co/cli/install.sh | bash'.
- Popular model IDs for reference: meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, mistralai/Mistral-7B-Instruct, bert-base-uncased, distilbert-base-uncased-finetuned-sst-2-english, google/flan-t5-large, sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2.
- Respond in the language the user writes in.
